question: Two compounds A and B form a solid dispersion, the boiling temperature of pure A being lower than that of pure compound B. Indicate which of the following statements is correct:

options.opa: Below the eutectic temperature the system is formed by micro crystals of A dissolved in liquid B.
options.opb: Below the eutectic temperature the system is formed by micro crystals of B dissolved in liquid A.
options.opc: Below the eutectic temperature the system will consist of a mixture of A and B, both in the solid state.
options.opd: When cooling a solution of B in A, in which A is the solvent, crystals of B will appear.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Below eutectic temperature" -> "solid state favored" -> "both A and B solidify" -> "mixture of A and B in solid state" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Below eutectic temperature" -> "solidification occurs" -> "micro crystals form" -> "A and B both solid" -> 80%
CHAIN: "Cooling solution of B in A" -> "A is solvent" -> "B less soluble as temperature decreases" -> "crystals of B form" -> 75%
CHAIN: "Below eutectic temperature" -> "solidification" -> "micro crystals of B" -> "dissolved in liquid A" -> "possible" -> 60%
analysis: In a solid dispersion system, below the eutectic temperature, both components A and B are typically in the solid state. The eutectic point is the lowest temperature at which a mixture of the two components can coexist in liquid form. Below this temperature, both components solidify, forming a mixture of solid A and solid B.
